verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਹਨ ਕੇ ਰੇਖ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਟਰੈ ਨ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਾਧ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਅਸਾਧ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: paahan ke rekh aadh a(n)t nirabaahu karai Tarai na saneh saadh bigreh asaadh ko ||

en.bdb: Just as a line drawn on a stone cannot be effaced and lasts till the stone perishes, so is the love of holy men with the Lord's feet and of vicious persons with evil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਲਕੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤਿ ਤਤ ਅਧਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਰੁਧ ਜੁਧ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal mai lakeer dheer na dharat tat adham kee preet aau birudh judh saadh ko ||

en.bdb: Just as line drawn on water does not last for a moment, so does the love of a wicked person and opposition or discord of a noble man vanishes in a wink.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋਹਰਿ ਉਖਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਸਾਧ ਅਧਮ ਉਪਾਧ ਕੋ॥
verses.translit_en: thohar ukhaaree upakaaree aau bikaaree sahaj subhaav saadh adham upaadh ko||

en.bdb: Just as cactus is painful due to its thorns and sugarcane is comforting and pleasant for its sweet juice, so is the temperament of an evil person who raises unpleasant situations while a saintly person remains peaceful and Endeavours to spread peace and happiness all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੰਜਾ ਫਲ ਮਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਮੋਲ ਅਲਪ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੋ ॥੩੮੩॥
verses.translit_en: gu(n)jaa fal maanak sa(n)saar tulaadhaar bikhai tol kai samaan mol alap agaadh ko ||383||

en.bdb: A ruby, and seed of Abrus Precatorius, may both be colored red but the seed is a lot less valuable. A noble and an evil person may look same but an evil person has no respect anywhere; a noble person is like a ruby - respected & valued by all. (383)
